exposure: laparoscopic scar diverticulum resection and suture
Control group (laparoscopic scar diverticulum resection and suture)
Observation group (hysteroscopic resection of scar diverticulum)
outcome: Diverticulum repair indexes (width, depth and lower uterine muscular layer thickness)
cohort: 89 patients with CSD after caesarean section
finding: Hysteroscopic resection of scar diverticulum in CSD reduced intraoperative blood loss and the risk of complications, shortened time of antibiotic administration, and promoted diverticulum repair compared to laparoscopic resection.
